svg.title: Gicp Steps
svg.desc: Two panels on Generalized ICP. (A) Probabilistic surface modelling: each source point p_i and target point q_i has a covariance ellipse (C_p, C_q) describing its local surface. (B) Plane-to-plane alignment: after transforming p_i by T, the residual d_i = q_i - T p_i is weighted by the sum of the covariances, minimising the Mahalanobis distance d_i transpose times (C_q + R C_p R transpose) inverse times d_i, so points can slide along both surfaces.
